anchors.name: unsigned_sota_ref
anchors.derivation: EinsteinArena's benchmark certificate for the (unsigned) autocorrelation constant C: a fixed 90,000-step nonnegative step-function certificate achieves autoconvolution ratio 1.5028503020710076. Cross-context: the known lower bound is C >= 1.28 (A. Cloninger, S. Steinerberger, "On Suprema of Autoconvolutions with an Application to Sidon sets," Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 145 (2017), 3191-3200, improving Matolcsi & Vinuesa's 2010 bound of 1.2748), independently corroborated by web search on 2026-09-06.

anchors.name: signed_sota_ref
anchors.derivation: Together AI, "New State-of-the-Art on the Third Autocorrelation Inequality" (2026): a fixed 400-step signed step-function certificate achieves the one-sided signed-autoconvolution ratio 1.4545548626983325, improving the prior published upper bound of 1.4581 (M. Matolcsi, C. Vinuesa, "Improved bounds on the supremum of autoconvolutions," J. Math. Anal. Appl. (2010), arXiv:0907.1379, as cited in the AlphaEvolve paper).
